title: HSK2 Gate 17 · Jin Dynasty
explanationEn: Gate 17: Jin Dynasty. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第17关：金朝。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 金朝的时候，北方住着很多不同的人。他们说的话不一样，写的字也不一样。因为要一起做事，所以很多年轻人开始学汉字。他们每天很早就去学校。
passageEn: In the Jin dynasty many different peoples lived in the north. They spoke differently and wrote differently. Because they had to work together, many young people began learning Chinese characters. They went to school very early each day.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: In the Jin dynasty many different peoples lived in the north.
comprehension.answer: 金朝的时候，北方住着很多不同的人。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Because they had to work together, many young people began learning Chinese characters.
comprehension.answer: 因为要一起做事，所以很多年轻人开始学汉字。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 时候 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“时候”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 时候 (shíhòu) means "period" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “时候”（shíhòu）的意思是“period”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 北 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“北”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 北 (běi) means "north" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “北”（běi）的意思是“north”，就在上面的短文里。

options.text: The water came into the fields, and into many people’s homes.
In the Jin dynasty many different peoples lived in the north.
Very long ago, it rained in China for many days.
Because there was so much rain, the water rose higher and higher.
